entities.name: Table T1 – Automotive Industry Regional Contributions to 2Q25 Global LV Production Growth
entities.brief: Waterfall chart of regional contributions to global LV production growth in 2Q25
entities.description: Breakdown of regional contributions to the forecasted 2.6% YoY global LV production growth in 2Q25

properties.table_content:
| Region | Contribution to Global LV Production Growth (YoY %) |
| :------------------- | :------------------------------------------------ |
| Greater China | 2.8% |
| South Asia | 0.6% |
| South America | 0.3% |
| Japan/Korea | 0.0% |
| Middle East/Africa | -0.2% |
| Europe | -0.3% |
| North America | -0.6% |
| Global | 2.6% |
properties.key_insight: Primary drivers of the forecasted 2.6% YoY global LV production growth in 2Q25 are Greater China (2.8%), South Asia (0.6%), and South America (0.3%), offset by drags from North America (-0.6%), Europe (-0.3%), and Middle East/Africa (-0.2%), with Japan/Korea neutral (0.0%).
